researchUpdatesLabel: OX pre-disclosure guidance; PHP's published advisories take precedence
note: Dated offline snapshot. PHP warns that web-serving installations are at risk. PHP 8.1 and older need maintained vendor backports or an upgrade. A version comparison does not verify vendor patch contents, deployed images, running workers, exposure or exploitation. Recheck vendor advisories; missing tracker data does not establish that a fix is unavailable. Updating is the only complete fix.

vulnerabilities.title: RCE via OOM corruption
vulnerabilities.prerequisites: Request processing encounters an allocation failure while internal state is partially initialized, followed by unsafe cleanup. PHP confirms pre-application unauthenticated RCE on mod_php; exploitability evidence differs across SAPIs.

vulnerabilities.title: RCE via stale global state
vulnerabilities.prerequisites: A persistent worker retains stale request state after an abnormal lifecycle and a later request reaches a consumer before initialization. Confirmed session-lifecycle paths include mod_php and FPM.
